criteria.intent: Retain the five active MEMORY sections and enforce inclusive 120-line and 8,192-byte UTF-8 limits.
criteria.automated_scope: The maintained RI guard and navigation test cover the actual configuration, exact limits, a multibyte overage and missing or inactive required headings.

criteria.intent: Provide a current worked handoff that another session can resume using verified source and work pointers.
criteria.automated_scope: The current inventory check verifies the handoff is indexed and its bytes match the generated views. Truth and resumption require the external handoff gate.

criteria.intent: Require concise replacement after meaningful progress, interruption, handoff and observed delivery or closure using the existing protocol.
criteria.automated_scope: Existing compact agent routing and RI/CI checks cover the maintained paths and check invocations. The lifecycle and treatment of decisions require independent inspection.

criteria.intent: Review and deliver the exact source through the trusted route for the complete repository-only candidate.
criteria.automated_scope: Existing style, RI inventory, coupling and continuity checks cover the bounded mechanical subset. Code-style judgment, all role results, trusted lane and merge are externally verified.

REQUIREMENTS.description: Independent Requirements & Acceptance review resolves the proposed byte cap before implementation, verifies the finished source against the stable criteria, and rechecks affected corrections.

HANDOFF.description: Independent Exploratory QA follows the worked MEMORY pointers, compares current facts to exact GitHub evidence, and reconstructs the stopping point, open acceptance and next action.

LIFECYCLE.description: Independent Code and Exploratory review the actual trigger and replacement protocol and the worked transition from a stale to a current handoff, with prior decisions and future actions distinguished.

CODE.description: Independent Code review covers the exact candidate, CS01/04/05/07/08/09/10, unautomated style rules, ownership and integration, and rechecks affected corrections.

WHITEBOX.description: Independent White-box QA verifies the boundary and false-positive cases with independent oracles and current-source evidence, and rechecks affected corrections.

DELIVERY.description: Verify exact-source affected checks, candidate capacity, the protected complete-diff route, native CI and the applicable admission evidence. Record merged protocol and dated handoff facts independently.

MERGE.description: Record the applicable maintainer decision and actual protected merge with exact source and merge identities before closure.
